items.title: Mongolian Heart to tour four European countries; proceeds to go to Bhotekoshi flood victims
items.summary: Kathmandu, September 22 Nepali pop band Mongolian Heart is heading to Europe for the first time in three decades. Under the “Mongolian Heart Europe Mini Tour 2026,” the band will perform live in four countries. The tour is being organised by Four Brothers Event Management. items.title: The nurse who wanted to heal Rasuwa
items.summary: Pratima Tamang Lama was a nurse, community worker, and ambitious local leader who dreamed of becoming Nepal’s health minister. The Bhotekoshi flood cut those dreams short.
